contentPattern.structure: avatar image + name (heading) + role + social links
contentPattern.note: Cards-style grid of person profiles. Each card: circular avatar + name (h3) + role/title (e.g. 'Artist | Photographer | Traveler') + a row of 3 icon-only social links (Facebook/Twitter/Instagram). Used twice on the About Us page: 'Our Contributors' (4) and 'WKND Guides' (3).

suitableFor: team / contributor / author profile grids (multiple people)
person-profile grids with avatar + name + role + social links
'meet the team' / 'our guides' style repeating profile cards
notSuitableFor: single author/contributor credit at the end of an article (use article-author)
article/product teaser grids with rectangular images + descriptions (use cards-teaser)

socialLinks.reason: The Facebook/Twitter/Instagram cluster appears only inside each person profile card, so a standalone 'social-links' sub-block is NOT warranted. Links are authored inline in the card body and decorated in place (grouped into .contributors-card-social). This mirrors article-author's social handling.
socialLinks.recommendation: Do not create a separate social-links block for this scope.

relatedBlocks.article-author: Single-person author credit (avatar + name + role + social). Same conceptual person-profile fields, but singular and article-scoped; its metadata explicitly directs multi-profile grids to cards. This 'contributors' variant is the grid counterpart and satisfies the Phase-3 'writer/photographer details' requirement (name, avatar, title) in a grid layout.

similarityScores.cards-teaser: ~35% (purpose person-profile vs article-teaser; imagePattern icon/avatar vs large; structure differs) - below 80% threshold
similarityScores.cards-related: ~20% (noimg link list vs avatar profile grid) - below 80% threshold
similarityScores.article-author: not a grid; single credit - not reusable for a multi-profile grid

usage.note: New custom variant of cards. Used twice on the About Us page: 'Our Contributors' grid (4 people) and 'WKND Guides' grid (3 people).
